label: Last original tokens / <DEL> of long sequences, strongest when the sequence starts with g
explanation: Fires only at absolute steps 5-9: the last one or two original tokens and the <DEL> step of long sequences (L>=7, about 76% of mass at L=9). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<5. The timing window (t 7-9, phase<=1) holds 95% of mass but only 4% of those steps are active, so the timing is necessary but not sufficient. Which steps fire, and how strongly, depends on the first original token: first_tok g gives 10.8x lift and 47% of mass, and the top activations nearly all start with g g. Other first tokens (2, t, u, p) contribute less. Restricting to first_tok==g gives about 0.41 precision and 0.31 recall; the remaining activations are weak and spread across many first tokens without a clean rule. The current input token has little effect (x, q, n, 1 and <DEL> are mildly enriched).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=g (+6.00), orig1=g (+3.91), orig0=2 (+3.51), to_go=1 (+3.22), orig0=t (+2.95), orig0=u (+2.46). Lower it: phase=2 (-10.44), next_out=- (-5.16), prev3_tok=- (-5.12), t=4 (-4.81).
